title: Enforce live outbound permission and customer scope across stock-out routes
description: Stage3 core inventory closure. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Require live enabled current user and actual stock-out menu before every controller list/detail/movement/options/create/update/submit/approve/cancel/delete route. Use authoritative CustomerId and existing SalespersonDataScopeService, database scope before counts/pagination. Enforce both stored and proposed customer before edit assignment; no missing-identity, restricted-unmapped or legacy-unlinked global fallback. Restrict source/order/warehouse evidence to existing legitimate privileges, no new grants or inferred warehouse ownership.

Apply compatible source-sales-order/stock-out deterministic row lock and atomic transaction to state/edit/delete operations so approved stock/ledger cannot race edits. Preserve ERP343 source quantity limits, ERP359 approved-return and ERP367 loading reversal guards. Failed authorization/proposed detail update or later posting leaves original document/stock/ledger unchanged; approval never duplicates inventory. Test actual controller SQL own/foreign/null source, revoked menu, disabled user, denied movement evidence, failed edit unchanged and concurrent edit/state transitions; retain existing fulfillment and ledger tests.
